title: Week 1 consolidation
topic: Missed topics drill — SCP, IAM roles, KMS, WAF scope, observability
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Answer without peeking at night-7-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×3 C×4 D×4 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: A developer with AdministratorAccess in a member account cannot launch RDS instances. IAM policies show Allow for rds:*. What is the most likely blocker?

options.A: An Organizations SCP explicitly denies rds:CreateDBInstance
options.B: CloudTrail is disabled in that Region so API calls fail
options.C: The VPC has no NAT Gateway for private RDS endpoints
options.D: AWS Config is recording too many resources in the account

questions.question: Account A wants Account B to attach a shared private subnet to a Transit Gateway. Which service enables the subnet share?

options.A: AWS IAM Identity Center for workforce SSO federation
options.B: AWS Organizations consolidated billing across accounts
options.C: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) for cross-account share
options.D: AWS Security Hub for aggregating security findings

questions.question: An ECS Fargate task cannot write logs to CloudWatch even though the task role has logs:CreateLogStream. What should you fix first?

options.A: Attach a WAF Web ACL to the task elastic network interface
options.B: Enable GuardDuty threat detection in the same Region
options.C: Move the Fargate task into a public subnet with an EIP
options.D: Add CloudWatch Logs permissions to the task execution role

questions.question: Account B must read S3 objects encrypted with Account A's customer managed KMS key. Which combination is required?

options.A: S3 bucket policy on Account A alone without any KMS grant
options.B: KMS key policy on the CMK for Account B plus IAM on B
options.C: Secrets Manager rotation enabled on the CMK in Account A
options.D: CloudFront Origin Access Control without updating the key

questions.question: After enabling SSE-KMS on a bucket with millions of small GET requests, KMS costs spike. Which S3 feature reduces KMS API charges?

options.A: S3 Transfer Acceleration for faster edge uploads
options.B: S3 Intelligent-Tiering for automatic access tiers
options.C: S3 Bucket Key to reduce per-object KMS Decrypt calls
options.D: S3 Object Lock in governance mode for WORM retention

questions.question: A team asks where to store a database password that must rotate automatically every 30 days. Best recommendation?

options.A: AWS KMS customer managed key used only for encryption
options.B: SSM Parameter Store String parameter with no encryption
options.C: CloudTrail log file delivered to an S3 audit bucket
options.D: AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation configured

questions.question: You need to enforce that all new S3 PutObject calls use SSE-KMS. Which control is most direct?

options.A: S3 bucket policy Deny unless SSE-KMS encryption is set
options.B: Enable GuardDuty S3 Protection for malware scanning
options.C: Attach Shield Advanced protection to the S3 bucket
options.D: Enable Amazon Macie sensitive-data discovery on the bucket

questions.question: You must attach a WAF Web ACL to a CloudFront distribution for globalskiatlas.com. In which Region and scope must you create the Web ACL?

options.A: Same Region as the S3 origin with REGIONAL WAF scope
options.B: Any Region — WAF Web ACLs are global for every scope
options.C: eu-west-1 because CloudFront edge locations are in Europe
options.D: us-east-1 with CLOUDFRONT scope for the distribution

questions.question: You need WAF on an Application Load Balancer in eu-central-1. What scope and Region apply?

options.A: CLOUDFRONT scope created only in us-east-1
options.C: REGIONAL scope in eu-central-1 with the ALB
options.D: REGIONAL scope that must live in us-east-1 only

questions.question: A CISO wants to deploy the same AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet WAF rules to 40 member accounts automatically. Best service?

options.A: AWS Firewall Manager for org-wide WAF policy rollout
options.B: AWS Security Hub for centralized findings dashboards
options.C: AWS Config rules evaluating resource configuration drift
options.D: Amazon Inspector for continuous vulnerability scanning

questions.question: An auditor needs cryptographic proof that CloudTrail log files were not modified after delivery to S3. Which feature?

options.A: CloudTrail data events logging S3 object-level API calls
options.B: CloudTrail log file validation using SHA-256 digests
options.C: CloudTrail Insights detecting unusual API activity rates
options.D: A multi-Region trail without enabling digest validation

questions.question: You need continuous evaluation of whether any IAM user currently lacks MFA enabled. Best approach?

options.A: CloudWatch metric alarm on IAM authentication API calls
options.B: CloudTrail log file validation for digest integrity checks
options.C: AWS Config managed rule such as iam-user-mfa-enabled
options.D: Amazon Macie jobs scanning IAM user access keys in S3

questions.question: Security Hub shows GuardDuty and Inspector findings in one prioritized dashboard. A separate team wants org-wide WAF policy deployment. Which mapping is correct?

options.A: Security Hub deploys WAF; Firewall Manager aggregates findings
options.B: Both Security Hub and Firewall Manager deploy WAF Web ACLs
options.C: Neither Security Hub nor Firewall Manager applies to WAF
options.D: Security Hub aggregates findings; Firewall Manager deploys WAF

questions.question: An S3 bucket policy allows s3:GetObject to Principal "*". Which tool analyzes whether resources are accessible from outside your AWS account?

options.A: AWS Control Tower for multi-account landing zone guardrails
options.B: IAM Access Analyzer for external access path findings
options.C: AWS Artifact for downloading compliance report packages
options.D: AWS Audit Manager for evidence collection frameworks

questions.question: A startup needs automated multi-account landing zones with guardrails and account vending. Which service?

options.A: AWS Control Tower with Account Factory and guardrails
options.B: IAM Access Analyzer for external resource access paths
options.C: Amazon Cognito user pools for application authentication
options.D: AWS Resource Groups for tagging-based resource collections
